reflection:
Direct-to-consumer self-publishing is definitely the way to go here. With 1.2M followers, she has the audience traditional publishers would charge massive cuts to reach.

Year 1: Focus on building up a backlog of content, while using free Instagram/TikTok polls to see which specific recipes her fans actually want in print.

Year 2: Arrange presales of the cookbook to fund the initial print run. That eliminates financial risk and keeps her budget intact.

Year 3: Launch the book directly to her audience and reinvest the profits into hiring a part-time editor so she can free up more time to create more content.
